item.tib: bder gshegs dgongs pa rgyud las sgrub gzhung mkha' 'gro ngo mtshar 'bum bzhed
item.coloph: snyigs ma'i kho bo o rgyan gar dbang rat+na gling pa'am/ ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma 'bod pa des mdo smad dngul rdza'i sgang stod spu rgyal gnas kyi nub phyogs a lung bsam 'grub rgyal khams kyi nye char dpag bsam g.yung drung rab brtan gling gi sku gdung gsar bzhengs kyi gdul bya ji g+hir hor gyi tha gru bon stod gron srib dkor yengs skabs su shel ri phyug mo dus babs gnas gter sgo 'byed kyi ma sring mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yang yang byung ba bzhin/ ing+ga ra zhes chu pho sprel gyi zla ba dang po'i bzhin ras ngoms pa'i nyin gnas chen shel ri phyug mo'i g.yas mdun/ brag ri tshe bum 'dra ba'i yang gong /ngo mtshar zla gam phug pa'i chu srin gre bar nas zab gter drangs te/ slar chu sprel zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bzang po nyin/ smin slob dbyangs can bzhed pa'i ming gis nye bar bskul ba la brten/ shog ser bod yig tu phab pas g.yung drung bon bstan rgyas pa'i cha can du gyur cig/
